caption: A competitor approaches the runway, accelerates, jumps, and lands with their legs spread wide.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A competitor approaches the runway, accelerates, jumps, and lands with their legs spread wide. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The competitor must approach the runway at a controlled speed.
The competitor must accelerate to achieve sufficient lift for the jump.
The competitor must execute a jump and land with legs spread wide on the runway.
The landing must be stable and within the designated runway area.
